scope: Public M/PRI API, derived analytics, stored runtime artifacts and source history

sources.finding: The library distinguishes its software license from Yahoo data rights and describes personal use. Direct Yahoo terms retrieval returned HTTP 999; no public-service permission was established.
sources.collection_decision: No new automated price download; local existing V1 replay only

sources.finding: Default terms cover private individual noncommercial use. Broader use requires a written agreement; adjusted daily endpoint is marked premium. No agreement or purchase was made.
sources.collection_decision: No key signup, paid endpoint or download

sources.finding: External display, derived outputs and redistribution have plan, attribution and exchange-specific conditions. Individual/internal use does not establish M/PRI public-service entitlement.
Individual market-data terms restrict public and derived redistribution. Commercial rights need a suitable agreement; no entitlement was obtained.
Historical download page required browser verification. Public-service rights, adjustment method and corporate-action coverage were not verified; free access is not treated as a license.
sources.collection_decision: No verification bypass or price download

sources.finding: FRED service conditions and series-owner rights must both be respected. Selected attributed commercial displays are described, but the intended public API and runtime artifact distribution are not blanket-approved.
sources.collection_decision: No new series collection or V1 factor replacement

sources.finding: Board-owned information is generally public domain with source citation, except identified third-party materials. Direct H.15 is a promising rate-source alternative, but endpoint, units, dates, revisions and parity still require technical validation.
sources.collection_decision: Does not resolve equity-price or VIX rights; no silent factor substitution

sources.finding: Website terms permit limited personal noncommercial copying; index data licensing is separately offered. A historical CSV or third-party open-data label is insufficient proof for M/PRI public derived use.
sources.collection_decision: No new VIX download, proxy or replacement
